title: Ocean shells on the Eridu ziggurat summit

tellings.quote: eridu I was able to identify uh ocean shells that are still on the zigurat summit that would have been more inclined to have like a Persian Gulf flood from the ocean

plain: Ocean shells still lie on top of the ziggurat, a stepped temple tower, at Eridu, an ancient city in southern Iraq, according to a researcher named Matt LaCroix, who says he identified them himself. He tells Michels the shells point to a flood coming in from the sea, out of the Persian Gulf, and he raises it while arguing that something huge happened to the world around 12,000 BC.
